encoding/hex#

Strict hexadecimal encoding.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HexEncoded(origin: [byte(0), byte(171), byte(255)]).string();
// "00abff"

HexDecoded(origin: "00ABff").bytes();
// [0, 171, 255]

Description#

Strict hexadecimal encoding.

Encoding always uses lowercase ASCII without a prefix. Decoding accepts lowercase and uppercase ASCII digits, but rejects 0x, whitespace, separators, underscores and every non-ASCII lookalike. Input length must be even. InvalidHex.offset() is a Unicode-scalar offset in the source string; an unmatched final nibble reports origin.length().
